'''Fush My First LSC''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fush]]
* '''Published:''' 22 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' We'll Handle This
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WHT Fush LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is my first shot at a LSC deck. Constructive feedback is welcome.

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

I've not got to playtest this deck yet, so any comments are welcome. I realize that I might have too many characters, and should probably replace some of them with high destiny cards. Which ones would be good? And I could probably also use some more of those combo cards.
